observation_note: Top-level date is the latest queue update; each candidate retains its own observation date.
purpose: Operator research leads only; this file is not a program_sources import or a terms review.

candidates.observed_page_role: Residential instant-savings program page; appliance offers and customer verification are described on the official page.
review_tasks: Review source access terms, robots policy, and fetch budget with the operator.
Verify current offer terms, dates, eligible products, and controlling linked documents from captured source bytes.
Map only verified ZIP and category scopes; ZIP presence must not establish Austin Energy service at an address.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official page says its energy efficiency rebate program has expired and rebates are unavailable.
review_tasks: Monitor the official page for a newly approved program before considering any current offer.
Review source access terms and map verified gas service geography separately from ZIP candidate discovery.
Do not use historical rebate PDFs as current terms.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official Texas status page says HOMES and HEAR rebates are not currently available and remain in design.
review_tasks: Monitor the official state page for DOE approval and launch details.
Review access terms and any controlling program documents after launch.
Derive ZIP/category mappings from verified data before enabling discovery fanout.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official manufacturer promotions directory; offer terms vary by model, purchase window, retailer, and geography.
review_tasks: Review access terms and capture current controlling offer documents, including eligible models and dates.
Map geography and appliance categories only from reviewed offer terms.
Do not treat this directory as a reviewed customer offer.

candidates.authority_name: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs
candidates.observed_page_role: Official WAP overview says subrecipients collectively cover all 254 Texas counties; it does not establish current household service capacity or a cash rebate.
review_tasks: Review source access terms and capture current program and subrecipient documents.
Verify county-to-subrecipient assignment, service capacity, income and measure rules with the responsible administrator.
Represent any eligible service as conditional in-kind work, not an advertised cash amount.

candidates.observed_page_role: CEC program overview describes HEEHRA, but the TECH program administrator reports all single-family reservations fully reserved since February 24, 2026 and multifamily reservations fully reserved since September 1, 2026; no new HEEHRA reservations are accepted.
review_tasks: Check the TECH administrator funding/status page before treating any CEC headline amount as available.
Track HEEHRA, HOMES and future phases separately; no new HEEHRA reservation is available on the observed date.
Review source access terms and controlling eligibility documents before automated retrieval or mapping.

candidates.authority_name: California Department of Community Services and Development
candidates.observed_page_role: Official residential efficiency overview describes DOE WAP and LIWP through local providers with income and other household screening; LIWP components have different dwelling scopes.
review_tasks: Review source access terms and capture current WAP, LIWP, provider and eligibility documents.
Verify county provider, dwelling type, measure eligibility, capacity and household conditions before any geographic mapping.
Distinguish conditional in-kind service from a cash rebate and keep WAP and LIWP as separate program reviews.

candidates.authority_name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
candidates.observed_page_role: Official live Consumer Rebate Program offers up to $2,500 per qualifying heat-pump water heater and up to $2,500 per ton for qualifying heat-pump HVAC, subject to active residential electric meter service, product tiers, application timing and limited funding.
review_tasks: Review source access terms, redirects, 2026 application and program terms before automated retrieval.
For heat-pump water heaters, capture capacity/UEF tiers, equipment model, installation permit and 12-month application deadline; verify active LADWP residential electric service at the address.
Confirm funding and product-specific terms at decision time; up-to amounts are not a household award.

candidates.observed_page_role: Federal 2025 Form 5695 instructions state that 25C and 25D residential credits terminate for relevant post-2025 dates; historical tax review only.
review_tasks: Review IRS primary instructions and applicable tax-year law before any historical calculation.
Do not map 25C or 25D as a current 2026 purchase incentive.
Keep taxpayer qualification and placed-in-service or expenditure dates for human review.

candidates.authority_name: Harris County Housing and Community Development
candidates.observed_page_role: Official county page currently accepts only septic and well health-and-safety projects; it has no current appliance or energy offer.
review_tasks: Review current intake, funding, source access terms, controlling eligibility and work scope.
Verify property is in the Harris County service area and outside any excluded municipality or overlapping jurisdiction.
Treat repair services as conditional and do not infer a cash amount for a device.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official San Antonio municipal utility weatherization page describes income guidelines and home upgrades.
review_tasks: Review access terms, 2026 income rules, qualified trade allies, current funding and measure scope.
Verify active CPS Energy service at the address; city or ZIP alone is insufficient.
Separate conditional installed measures from fixed cash rebates.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official ESA page describes no-cost measures for eligible customers and says some electrification enrollment is closed.
review_tasks: Review access terms, current program status, income, dwelling, meter and measure rules.
Verify active SCE service and address-level measure availability.
Keep closed or exhausted components out of current offers.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official promotions directory leads to time-limited product and package offers; a directory is not an individual offer.
review_tasks: Review access terms and capture the controlling form for each specific offer.
Verify model, retailer, bundle, purchase, submission, state and county restrictions and remaining funds.
Do not assign a package rebate to an individual appliance.

candidates.observed_page_role: Federal Tribal HEAR fact sheet documents a grant path for sovereign administrators; it is not an individual Tribe program notice or household offer.
review_tasks: Review DOE access terms and current grant/award status; identify each sovereign administrator separately.
Seek current Tribe-issued program notices, membership and service geography, and controlling benefits.
Do not infer program launch or household eligibility from a formula allocation.

candidates.observed_page_role: Federal WAP is an active household weatherization service delivered by state and local providers; income, provider capacity and audit determine services. It is not a national cash rebate.
review_tasks: Review official DOE and state/local eligibility, provider, funding and measure terms.
Do not duplicate state WAP offers as separate federal awards.
Review host access terms before automated retrieval.

candidates.authority_name: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs
candidates.observed_page_role: 2026 LIHEAP-backed CEAP provides conditional utility-bill assistance through subrecipients covering all 254 counties; 2026 state plan and amendment are posted.
review_tasks: Verify county provider, income, household priority, benefit calculation and remaining local funds.
Keep utility-bill assistance distinct from appliance purchase rebates.
Review host access terms before automated retrieval.

candidates.authority_name: California Department of Community Services and Development
candidates.observed_page_role: California reports FY2026 LIHEAP funding for energy-bill and weatherization assistance; local providers determine service and prioritize vulnerable households.
review_tasks: Verify local provider, income, priority, available service and funding.
Do not imply every income-eligible household receives a benefit.
Review host access terms before automated retrieval.

candidates.observed_page_role: Official current $1,000 rebate for qualifying ENERGY STAR heat-pump water heater, installed with permanent Austin Energy electric service; application within 90 days of purchase, subject to limited funding.
review_tasks: Verify active electric service, equipment model, size, age of any replaced heat-pump unit, permit and 90-day application window.
Check funding and application approval; published amount is conditional.
Review host access terms before automated retrieval.

candidates.authority_name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
candidates.observed_page_role: Official marketplace lists October 2026 purchase-window rebates for selected window AC units, refrigerators and smart thermostats; active LADWP residential account required.
review_tasks: Verify product model, active electric account and October 2026 purchase and December 31, 2026 application windows.
Check marketplace rebate display and funding for specific items; do not present up-to amounts as guaranteed.
Review host access terms before automated retrieval.
